// Tazeen Commerce platform database (tazeen_pos_db).
// IDs: UUIDv7 (time-ordered), generated by Prisma; never derived from phone/SKU/invoice/serial.
// Foundation only: no invoices, orders, payments, wallet, returns, engagement, notifications, loyalty.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum CustomerStatus {
  ACTIVE
  INACTIVE
  BLOCKED
}

enum IdentityProvider {
  PHONE_OTP
  TRUECALLER
  EMAIL
  GOOGLE
  APPLE
}

enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  ACTIVE
  ARCHIVED
}

enum LocationType {
  STORE
  WAREHOUSE
  ONLINE_FULFILLMENT
}

enum InventoryMovementType {
  OPENING
  PURCHASE_RECEIPT
  SALE
  RETURN
  ADJUSTMENT
  TRANSFER_IN
  TRANSFER_OUT
}

model Customer {
  id        String         @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // Normalized E.164 (e.g. +919876543210). Nullable: future email-only customers. Not a key.
  phone     String?        @unique @db.VarChar(20)
  name      String?        @db.VarChar(200)
  status    CustomerStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  identities CustomerIdentity[]

  @@index([status])
  @@map("customers")
}

// One row per way a customer can sign in (phone OTP, Truecaller, email, ...).
model CustomerIdentity {
  id              String           @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  customerId      String           @map("customer_id") @db.Uuid
  provider        IdentityProvider
  // Provider-side identifier: phone number, Truecaller id, email, OAuth subject.
  providerSubject String           @map("provider_subject") @db.VarChar(320)
  verifiedAt      DateTime?        @map("verified_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  lastUsedAt      DateTime?        @map("last_used_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  customer Customer @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([provider, providerSubject])
  @@index([customerId])
  @@map("customer_identities")
}

model Product {
  id          String        @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  name        String        @db.VarChar(300)
  brand       String?       @db.VarChar(200)
  description String?
  status      ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  variants ProductVariant[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([name])
  @@map("products")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  productId  String   @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  name       String?  @db.VarChar(200)
  // Free-form variant attributes (e.g. {"size":"M","color":"Blue"}).
  attributes Json?
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  skus    Sku[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_variants")
}

// Sellable unit. Both code systems live on the same row so the old->new mapping is explicit
// and neither code is ever replaced or deleted. At least one of sku12 / legacySku8 is required
// and formats are enforced by CHECK constraints in the migration.
model Sku {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  variantId  String   @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  // New 12-digit SKU. Null while an item exists only under its legacy code.
  sku12      String?  @unique @db.VarChar(12)
  // Historical 8-digit SKU, preserved permanently.
  legacySku8 String?  @unique @map("legacy_sku8") @db.VarChar(8)
  // Future barcode support (EAN/UPC/internal); not enforced beyond uniqueness.
  barcode    String?  @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  variant        ProductVariant  @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  inventoryItems InventoryItem[]

  @@index([variantId])
  @@map("skus")
}

model Location {
  id        String       @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String       @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String       @db.VarChar(200)
  type      LocationType
  isActive  Boolean      @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  inventoryItems InventoryItem[]

  @@index([type])
  @@map("locations")
}

// Current stock of one SKU at one location. (Reservations will be added later.)
model InventoryItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  locationId     String   @map("location_id") @db.Uuid
  skuId          String   @map("sku_id") @db.Uuid
  quantityOnHand Int      @default(0) @map("quantity_on_hand")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  location  Location            @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  sku       Sku                 @relation(fields: [skuId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  movements InventoryMovement[]

  @@unique([locationId, skuId])
  @@index([skuId])
  @@map("inventory_items")
}

// Append-only stock ledger. quantityDelta is signed and never zero (CHECK in migration).
model InventoryMovement {
  id              String                @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  inventoryItemId String                @map("inventory_item_id") @db.Uuid
  type            InventoryMovementType
  quantityDelta   Int                   @map("quantity_delta")
  reason          String?               @db.VarChar(500)
  // Optional pointer to the business document that caused it (added later: sale, transfer, ...).
  referenceType   String?               @map("reference_type") @db.VarChar(50)
  referenceId     String?               @map("reference_id") @db.VarChar(100)
  createdAt       DateTime              @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  inventoryItem InventoryItem @relation(fields: [inventoryItemId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([inventoryItemId, createdAt])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([referenceType, referenceId])
  @@map("inventory_movements")
}
